items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: the reason you and Bishay broke up, the reason he left the band? ... Bishay won't save prices as the manager

ctx.x: Well, what does that story, he said, how the reason you and Bishay broke up, the reason he left the band?

Oh, Bishay won't save prices as the manager, that's the trouble. Yeah. Because he read and I read and he didn't read. He won't save prices. I told you, you don't get it. He said, well, I don't stay. Well, he goes there, Joe, you'll grab him right off the reel of it. He went to Europe. Yeah. Plenty of everything. Yeah.
He's a great guy, isn't he?
